描述_EN: the figure's head is movable. its body made of earthenware with aubergine and turquoise glaze. this is the figure of a state official's attendant, both hands missing. this type of earthenware figure was mass-produced to be buried with the deceased.
描述_ZN: 该人物的头部是可移动的。 其身体是由带有茄子和绿松石釉的陶器制成。 这是一个国家官员的随从的形象，两只手都不见了。 这种陶俑是大量生产的，与死者一起埋葬。
